Manage Plivo applications (voice/messaging webhooks)

Usage:
  plivo account applications [flags]
  plivo account applications [command]

Aliases:
  applications, app, application

Available Commands:
  create      Create a new application
  delete      Delete an application (requires --yes)
  get         Get application details
  list        List applications
  update      Update an application

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for applications

Global Flags:
      --dry-run            print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain            explain what the command will do before executing
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --timeout int        request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts

Use "plivo account applications [command] --help" for more information about a command.
